quote: visual storytelling is the task of generating a sequence of textual descriptions ({T 1 , T 2 , ..., T n }) from a sequence of images ({I 1 , I 2 , ..., I n })

One such widely studied task is image captioning which provides a textual description T given an image I. In contrast, visual storytelling is the task of generating a sequence of textual descriptions ({T1, T2, ..., Tn}) from a sequence of images ({I1, I2, ..., In}).
We present a Visual Procedure Telling (ViPT) dataset similar to the Visual Storytelling (ViST) dataset with 46k procedures on various domains.
